Static file serving helpers. Serves embedded assets via service/assets and disk assets via mimedb with traversal protection, ETags, conditional requests, byte ranges and download support.

Imports

../network/webserver, ../service/assets, application

Procs

proc fileETag(size: int64; mtime: Time): string {....raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
Weak ETag from file size + mtime (W/"<size>-<mtime>", hex). Stable for unchanged files, changes on any write. Pure, unit-testable. 
proc httpDate(t: Time): string {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Formats t as an HTTP date for Date / Last-Modified. 
proc isTraversalPath(path: string): bool {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
True when path escapes its base directory (any .. segment). Check the normalized path before joining it to a base directory: traversal attempts are treated as not-found (no information leak). 
proc mimeFor(ext: string): string {....raises: [OpenParserJsonError, ValueError,
    KeyError], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Maps a file extension (with or without leading dot, possibly empty) to a MIME type. Never raises, even for missing/odd extensions. 
proc notModified(req: var Request; etag: string): bool {....raises: [KeyError],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}
True when the request's If-None-Match matches etag (or is *). Pure header check — no I/O, unit-testable.
